scientific_integrity: The proof states its classical analytic premises, exact arithmetic construction, full quantifiers, and limitations. Previously proved fifth-power bound and two-prime Zumkeller criterion are credited. Finite checks illustrate but do not certify the infinite theorem. Absolute publication priority is not certified.
scientific_limitations: The theorem gives a uniform local asymptotic lower bound for sufficiently large odd targets only. It does not assert a global exact asymptotic, optimal logarithmic exponent, effective threshold, individual small-exception classification or any statement for even targets.
title: A sharp local prime-sieve lower bound for Zumkeller complements
